Synopsis:
Dialogue with the ghost of Illasera, bound to eternal service to Bhaal in her afterlife. In "Baldur's Gate 2: Throne of Bhaal", Illasera was one of the Five, an evil group of Bhaalspawn led by Amelyssan.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Illasera.json: Illasera was one of the Five Bhaalspawn in Baldur’s Gate 2 and now appears as a bound, unquiet spirit serving Bhaal—an echo that presides as one of his “Justices.” In this scene she recognizes the player as a Child of Murder/Bhaalspawn and speaks as if pronouncing their role: an Unholy Assassin and chosen butcher who will lead others to slaughter. Off‑screen this implies the player has been marked by Bhaal’s influence (a tadpole/True Soul or recently used/accepted murderous power), which has triggered the vision; her words mix prophecy, duty, and coercion rather than ordinary praise. Read her lines as supernatural, manipulative commands rooted in Bhaal’s afterlife hierarchy, not friendly counsel.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Amelyssan.json: Dialogue with the ghost of Amelyssan, bound to eternal service to Bhaal in her afterlife. In "Baldur's Gate 2: Throne of Bhaal", she attempted to usurp Bhaal's portfolio of murder and absorb Bhaal's essence. Now she is no more than a spectral slave.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Dolor.json: Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_DeathKnight.json: Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Merchant.json: After completing the Murder Tribunal trial and completing the Baptism of Blood, the Echo of Abazigal will appear in the courtroom to provide you with Bhaalist/assassiny wares. Abazigal was one of the Five Bhaalspawn from BG2: Throne of Bhaal.

- Echo of Illasera: You are to be commended, though I expected nothing less from a Child of Murder. (node 31)
- Player: It's perfect. Finally I feel free. (node 38)

Dialogue with the ghost of Amelyssan, bound to eternal service to Bhaal in her afterlife. In "Baldur's Gate 2: Throne of Bhaal", she attempted to usurp Bhaal's portfolio of murder and absorb Bhaal's essence. Now she is no more than a spectral slave.

Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.

Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.

After completing the Murder Tribunal trial and completing the Baptism of Blood, the Echo of Abazigal will appear in the courtroom to provide you with Bhaalist/assassiny wares. Abazigal was one of the Five Bhaalspawn from BG2: Throne of Bhaal.
context: Illasera here is the spectral echo of one of the Five Bhaalspawn from Baldur’s Gate 2, now bound in Bhaal’s afterlife as one of his “Justices” who preside over the Murder Tribunal. The player is being addressed as a Child of Murder and a “fresh Unholy Assassin,” which implies off‑screen that they have been marked by Bhaal’s influence (the tadpole/True Soul route or use/acceptance of murderous power) and are at or immediately after the tribunal/initiation (the Baptism of Blood). Illasera’s lines are supernatural pronouncements of duty and coercive prophecy—commands rooted in Bhaal’s hierarchy, not friendly counsel. The scene takes place in the tribunal’s subterranean courtroom, guarded by death knights and attended by other bound echoes of Bhaalspawn.
